noUpdates.en: The installed version is the latest.

updateBlockedDsh.en: Requires DSH >= {min}; upgrade DSH before updating
updateBlockedDsh.zh: 需要 DSH ≥ {min}，请先升级 DSH 再更新

updateUnverifiedDsh.en: Cannot confirm the local DSH version (this update needs DSH >= {min}); update paused
updateUnverifiedDsh.zh: 无法确认本机 DSH 版本（需要 DSH ≥ {min}），已暂停更新

restartHint.en: Plugin changes take effect after restarting the application.
restartHint.zh: 插件变更将在重启应用后生效。

thirdPartyOnly.en: Third-party plugins only; @deepseek-ai/ packages upgrade with DSH itself.
thirdPartyOnly.zh: 只检查第三方插件；官方 @deepseek-ai/ 包随 DSH 本体升级。

restartPlanRelaunch.en: The DSH service restarts; running tasks are interrupted.
restartPlanRelaunch.zh: 会重启 DSH 服务，正在运行的任务会中断。

restartPlanShell.en: The desktop app restarts through its system dialog: confirming shows the official "DeepSeek Harness is unavailable" dialog; click Restart in it.
restartPlanShell.zh: 桌面版通过系统对话框重启：确认后会弹出官方的「应用无法启动或已意外停止」对话框，请在对话框中点「重启」。

restartPlanManual.en: This process cannot restart itself; restart DSH yourself.
restartPlanManual.zh: 当前进程无法自动重启，请手动重启 DSH。

restartShellWarning.en: It also writes a crash report. You can instead restart manually: quit DeepSeek Harness (Cmd+Q) and open it again.
restartShellWarning.zh: 它同时会写一份崩溃报告；也可以手动重启：退出 DeepSeek Harness（⌘Q）后重新打开。

restartDesktopHint.en: Choose Restart in the system dialog that follows.
restartDesktopHint.zh: 请在随后出现的系统对话框中选择「重启」。

restartRelaunchHint.en: Restart requested; reload the page once the server is back.
restartRelaunchHint.zh: 已请求重启；服务恢复后刷新页面即可。

restartManualHint.en: This process cannot restart itself; restart DSH yourself.
restartManualHint.zh: 当前进程无法自动重启，请手动重启 DSH。

localOnlyBody.en: To protect host configuration, plugin management is only available from a local browser.
localOnlyBody.zh: 为了保护主机配置，插件管理只能从本机打开。
